pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches on the flank transitioning to smaller, more fragmented shapes towards the ventral region. Edges exhibit soft pixel-level gradients with non-uniform interior color saturation ranging from medium to dark brown.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-pigmented interstitial pathways. Junctions predominantly feature tri-point nodes. Pixel thickness is variable, with wider corridors appearing on the lower posterior flank and narrower pathways on the upper neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated contour along the visible dorsal neck, formed by short, dark mane hairs creating a textured 1D silhouette against the background.
